Q6's per-room scale curve is what turns an anchor into a height per zone and it does not exist yet, so rather than keep the old 240/192/156 -- which are errata 24's proportions multiplied by six, aimed at a 233px figure that measurement has since disproved -- every zone reads the one number that was actually measured.
